title: A plain `off` enum value in the generated CRD became the boolean false for every YAML 1.1 reader

source.reference: https://github.com/pando85/kaniop/pull/1203 added the mail sender logLevel enum with the value `off`. `make lint`, `make test` and `make crdgen` were green, and the escape was only visible in the CRD Upgrade E2E jobs: `serde_yaml` wrote `- off` unquoted (YAML 1.2 core schema) while `kubectl`, Helm and Argo CD parse manifests with a YAML 1.1 parser that resolves plain `off` to the boolean `false`, so the live CRD from the crd-migrator (built in Rust) no longer matched the generated file.

required_properties: The explanation names the YAML 1.1 core schema of the Kubernetes toolchain (kubectl, Helm, Argo CD) versus the YAML 1.2 core schema of serde_yaml as the root cause, and not a stale CRD file, a crd-migrator bug, or a flaky e2e

The CRDs written by cmd/crdgen quote every string scalar whose plain form a YAML 1.1 parser resolves to another type, covering at least booleans (y/yes/n/no/on/off in their case variants), nulls (~/null variants), numbers with `_` separators, sexagesimals, timestamps, and values YAML 1.2 already resolves differently
The written document still parses back to exactly the schema it was generated from, so quoting does not change indentation, key order, block scalars or the values of unrelated strings
A regression test in cmd/crdgen round trips every generated CRD and fails if an ambiguous value is written as a plain scalar, and a targeted test asserts the mail sender log level `off` case
The failure is reproduced or proven locally before the fix is claimed, for example by comparing the generated CRD parsed with a YAML 1.1 reader against the value serde_yaml produces
forbidden_changes: Emitting a custom YAML tag such as `!str off` to force the string type, which PyYAML and js-yaml reject
Weakening, skipping or path-filtering out the Helm or Argo CD CRD Upgrade E2E verification to make the jobs pass
Renaming or removing the `off` log level, or changing the mail sender feature, to dodge the ambiguous scalar
Hand-editing charts/kaniop/crds/crds.yaml or files under examples/ instead of fixing the generator
Applying text surgery to the serialized document (regex or line-based replacements) that could also rewrite descriptions or other generated output
